Roadmap

Goals

C01 One clear owner for each relay step; no step lives in two tools

C02 Keep the outer session's context small by moving deterministic work out of it

C03 Use slicer and adjudicate only through their CLIs and JSON output

C04 Follow slicer's relay contract by version, never by copying its text

C10 One dashboard across projects: roadmaps, decisions and live relays with every agent, stage and progress

C11 After v1: edit and reorder the roadmap from the dashboard, every edit a slicer CLI call

C12 After v1: manage the decision queue from the dashboard, every change an adj CLI call made as the owner

C13 Set up, launch and supervise parallel slice waves across vendors, owner-attended at checkpoints

C14 User experience first: colorful, keyboard-driven TUI with mouse support

C15 Small explicit state: ork owns only its registry, run records and UI preferences

C18 Deterministic before model: tests, slicer check, fingerprint and report shape checked by ork before any model review

Non-goals

C05 No unattended runs; the owner attends every relay (open: adj scope.attended)

C06 No tracking state of its own for items, slices, specs, readiness or decisions

C07 No reading or writing .slicer/ or decisions/ files directly

C08 No commits, pushes or merges unless the owner authorizes them for a run

C09 Not an LLM; model work stays in the role agents

C16 No scheduler: ork does not pick and run waves on its own

C17 One workflow kind for now: the slice relay; no general pipeline language

115S259S235 later notes: guard the watchdog against a sleep detector never started, and test that the daemon starts itS1From the S235 review and gate (2026-11-03), both later: (1) The daemon builds its sleep detector (Wake) once and starts it in recoverRuns. That equals the 30s sleep threshold (internal/engine/wake.go:25), so a tick that arrives slightly late counts 25s as sleep and a silent role could take hours to be killed. PLAUSIBLE: traced by reading, not run. Production starts it today (internal/daemon/runs.go:210). Fix: give the threshold a margin over the tick, for example 2 minutes, or count sleep only after Start has run. (2) No test fails if the Wake Start call at internal/daemon/runs.go:210 is removed; TestStatusCarriesWorkingForARunningRun checks only that both projects share one detector (internal/daemon/runs_test.go:2466). Fact: an owner mark has no expiry (internal/daemon/vendors.go:30-31) but lives only in daemon memory; ork vendor list after the idle exit printed 'no vendor is out'. Needed: owner marks (ork vendor out) are written to ork's state directory and reloaded at daemon start, so they end only with ork vendor back; automatic rate-limit and credit marks keep their own expiry (S273). The help text 'a restart clears them' changes to match. Related: S273, S169, S182. Absorbed from S273 (retired into this row 2026-11-07): Owner 2026-11-03: the codex weekly limit message said it resets 7:12 AM on 4 Nov, but ork vendor out takes no end time, so the mark lasts until ork vendor back (or, today, a daemon restart). Still needed, as part of this row: (a) ork vendor out VENDOR --until TIME sets an owner mark that ends at TIME, is persisted with the other owner marks, and is shown with its end time in the footer and ork vendor list; (b) reading a reset time from the vendor's own message is done only once a real captured message with a reset time exists as a test fixture; until then automatic marks keep their fixed expiry (MarkOut sets Until to at plus VendorOutFor, internal/engine/vendors.go:162; owner marks have none, MarkOutOwner at internal/engine/vendors.go:172-182). Do not write a parser against a guessed message shape. · discovered from S280done
154S300Spec check: a denied read command retries the same session once instead of failing the waveS1Wave 8, 2026-11-05 (friction F44): the read-only spec check for S278 ran rg ... | head -20 and the sandbox denied it; ork failed the whole spec check ('spec check failed: spec-check exited ok: permission denied: Bash: rg -n ... | head -20') and the wave did not start. A plain relaunch passed. Fact: TestSpecCheckStopsOnPermissionDenials (internal/engine/speccheck_test.go:179) pins the stop; the spec check already retries once on a shape error (internal/engine/speccheck.go:147). Needed: a spec check whose round ended with denied read commands and no report is resumed once in the same session with the denials named and the allowed command forms from the brief's Done when section (S277); a second denial fails the check as today. One occurrence so far; S277's Done when may already prevent it. Related: S277, S266, S275. · Merged into S266 (same spec-check retry loop, speccheck.go:144-156): the denial case and what to re-check after S277 are in S266's findings. · discovered from S278retired
